# Eight SaaS renewals coming: which do you negotiate first, and when does the window close?

> Paste your SaaS subscriptions and get the last day to give notice before each auto-renewal, which renewals to negotiate first, a floor and stretch target price, a calendar file and an email draft per vendor. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
